+# FORGE inductive-bias port into COMPOSE-Lipid
+
+The port is frozen in
+[`configs/model/forge_inductive_bias_port_v1.json`](../configs/model/forge_inductive_bias_port_v1.json).
+It binds the exact FORGE implementation reviewed at commit
+`f58c679594c49312cde666de0fe293bf6ba5c54e` and maps each transferable rule to
+the current COMPOSE-Lipid implementation.
+
+The central ruling is to preserve FORGE's scientific constraints in COMPOSE's
+native representation. COMPOSE remains one reaction-grounded whole-molecule
+reference process. It does not become a Ugi component generator.
+
+## What is carried over
+
+- Canonical scientific roles and anonymous region instances condition the model.
+  Component catalogue IDs do not become neural categories.
+- Regions communicate through one whole-graph model. Heads, linkers and tails
+  are not independently sampled.
+- Reaction cores, ports, event order, observed occupancy, hydrogen reserves,
+  valence, charge, atom/bond vocabulary and connectedness are exact support.
+- Cycles are structured topology. COMPOSE uses training-derived typed ring
+  templates and exact ring actions; invalid, duplicate, unsupported or
+  valence-breaking closures never enter the candidate set. Terminal repair is
+  forbidden.
+- Exterior size, junction budget, cycle rank and attachment count are joint
+  anonymous regional conditions. More detailed lipid morphology remains a soft
+  learned/calibrated signal unless a reaction contract makes it exact.
+- Evaluation resolves ring placement and morphology by head, interface/linker
+  and hydrophobe, because correct pooled ring prevalence can hide rings in the
+  wrong part of a lipid.
+
+FORGE's strongest relevant semantic result is also respected: aligned regional
+labels helped every prediction head across three paired seeds, while a
+dimension-matched but permuted label channel recovered essentially none of the
+gain. The COMPOSE ablation therefore removes neural programme/morphology
+information without changing rows, hard support or model size.
+
+For the v8.1 health gate, the typed ring catalog is built from every
+ring-bearing exact path in the full 159,782-target training fold. It is not
+limited to the smaller set sampled into the 6,000-step health schedule.
+Acyclic paths are omitted from catalog construction because they add no ring
+template. Calibration paths can reveal an unseen train-support topology and
+enter an explicit held-out panel, but they cannot expand the catalog.
+
+## What is deliberately not copied
+
+The Ugi-specific five-atom core, three roles, cycle-rank ceiling of two and
+five/six-member ring support are properties of that FORGE instantiation. They
+are not universal lipid rules. COMPOSE instead derives ring templates and
+support from its frozen training paths across 23 reaction families.
+
+The current four-field regional encoder is the bounded first health arm. If it
+is exact-valid but topology-poor under the frozen chemistry-only panels, the
+next model revision is a rooted topology plus sparse-closure stage. Post-hoc
+filters are not allowed to conceal that failure.
+
+Run the audit with:

+# COMPOSE-Lipid v8.1 modelling readiness
+
+Date: 2026-09-18. Status: target measure frozen; exact model-program and path
+materialization are next. No GPU training has run.
+
+## Outcome
+
+The 200,000-molecule chemistry corpus was not rebuilt or filtered again. Its
+component representation and model-facing evaluation split were corrected
+before fitting any training distribution.
+
+- Corpus: 200,000 unique constitutional targets, comprising 11,267 reported
+  source anchors and 188,733 exact virtual constructions.
+- Complete-component manifest: all 200,000 targets resolved into canonical,
+  stereo-free precursor constitutions with family roles and multiplicities;
+  45,515 globally unique component constitutions.
+- Split: 159,782 train, 19,975 calibration, 19,975 formal test, and 268
+  reference-only.
+- Target measure: all 159,782 train targets, 23 supported reaction families,
+  equal expected family mass, bounded source confidence, and no Michael/BEAE
+  family tilt.
+- Biology, BEAE outcomes, and GPU use: none.
+
+The authoritative artifacts are:
+
+- `artifacts/corpus_build_v2/post_instruction_component_manifest_v8_1/`
+- `artifacts/corpus_build_v2/post_instruction_generator_splits_v8_1/`
+- `artifacts/corpus_build_v2/post_instruction_target_measure_v8_1/`
+- `audits/post_instruction_generator_splits_v8_1_independent.json`
+- `audits/post_instruction_target_measure_v8_1_independent.json`
+
+## Why the old split was superseded
+
+The v8 corpus remains the accepted chemistry release. The old v8 split is no
+longer model-facing because its precursor grouping used family metadata IDs
+rather than a uniform structural identity. That created two problems:
+
+1. some IDs collapsed many distinct complete reagents, most visibly in the
+   Vitamin-B5 family; and
+2. the same complete molecular constitution could have different IDs across
+   families.
+
+When the old 7,002-row `unseen_precursor_identity` panel was re-audited using
+canonical complete-component structures, 3,734 rows had no component structure
+that was actually absent from training. This was an evaluation-label defect,
+not evidence that the molecules or reaction constructions were wrong.
+
+The corrected v8.1 split uses globally scoped canonical component
+constitutions. Its independent audit found:
+
+- zero selected component structures in training;
+- zero selected source studies in training across all formal families;
+- zero exact-combination semantic failures;
+- zero coarse-morphology semantic failures; and
+- every formal test row assigned to at least one named panel.
+
+The term **regional morphology** is deliberate. The corresponding signature is
+a grouped, coarse regional/whole-molecule descriptor. It is not exact graph
+topology and must not be reported as such.
+
+## Frozen test panels
+
+The 19,975 formal test targets cover:
+
+- unseen complete component structure: 9,259 targets;
+- unseen exact component combination: 4,676 targets;
+- unseen coarse regional morphology: 5,512 targets; and
+- globally held source study: 532 targets.
+
+Four targets belong to more than one panel. Exact-combination targets use only
+components observed in the training set of the same reaction family. Selected
+source PMIDs are absent from training across every formal family.
+

+
+Panel counts are not required to be equal within a family. The split fills each
+family's fixed 10% test quota using the strongest available non-overlapping
+structural groups. A zero in one panel therefore means another panel used that
+family's quota; it does not remove that family from formal evaluation.
+
+## Train-only target measure
+
+The target measure follows decision 0037:
+
+- each of the 23 supported reaction families receives probability mass
+  `1 / 23`;
+- within a mixed family, a source target can receive at most four times the
+  per-target mass of a virtual target;
+- targets are uniform within each family/evidence stratum;
+- regional morphology remains a joint empirical train-only condition rather
+  than independently sampled marginal knobs; and
+- no Michael-addition or BEAE-adjacent family receives extra base-model mass.
+
+The realized global source-anchor probability mass is 0.1352664556. This is
+below 0.5 because the fourfold per-target cap prevents a few source rows from
+dominating much larger virtual strata. The measure contains 15,162 empirical
+joint family-core/morphology groups.
+
+All 159,782 train targets retain mass, including 2,297 source targets whose
+compatible decompositions still need projection into the exact model-program
+format. They may not be silently dropped or replaced. A projection failure is
+a readiness blocker to fix, not permission to redraw the training set.
+
+## FORGE-derived inductive biases that remain binding
+
+The corpus and measure do not replace the model architecture. The base process
+must retain:
+
+- anonymous, permutation-equivariant region and port embeddings;
+- canonical reaction roles rather than source-specific component IDs;
+- joint regional context rather than independent head/tail marginals;
+- semantic regional organization without component-factorizing the generated
+  molecule;
+- exact reaction program, scaffold, port, occupancy, valence, charge, and
+  hydrogen support as hard constraints;
+- branch, length, unsaturation, ester placement, ring, and composition as soft
+  family-aware morphology signals rather than universal hard quotas;
+- alias aggregation for primitive actions reaching the same successor; and
+- exact execution state kept separate from canonical identity/deduplication.
+
+The regional context is fitted on train only. Calibration may select the soft
+regional guidance strength and compare the regional model with its matched
+ablation. Formal test and BEAE do not select the base model.
+
+## Next gate
+
+1. Project every weighted supervision record into an exact model program.
+2. Preserve one frozen program witness per target; do not multiply target mass
+   by alternative routes or path length.
+3. Materialize exact paths in restartable shards with one CPU per worker and at
+   most four local workers.
+4. Run CPU replay, candidate-support, alias-aggregation, cached/live parity, and
+   regional permutation-invariance checks.
+5. Only then launch the bounded regional-context versus matched-ablation health
+   run.
+
+The base chemistry process remains broad and outcome-blind. The later pulmonary
+controller operates over frozen supported regional programs and scores completed
+endpoints; it does not alter this training measure.

+from __future__ import annotations

+import json

+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

+OUTPUT = ROOT / "artifacts/modeling/forge_inductive_bias_port_v1_final"

+    config = json.loads(CONFIG.read_text())
+    if config.get("schema") != "forge_inductive_bias_port_v1":
+        raise ValueError("unsupported FORGE port contract")
+    if config.get("biology_used") or config.get("beae_outcomes_used"):
+        raise ValueError("base-process inductive-bias audit must remain biology-free")
+    forge = (ROOT / config["forge_source"]["repository"]).resolve()
+    observed_forge = {}
+    for relative, expected in config["forge_source"]["files"].items():
+        path = forge / relative
+        observed = sha256_file(path)
+        if observed != expected:
+            raise ValueError("changed bound FORGE source: " + relative)
+        observed_forge[relative] = observed
+
+    current = config["current_compose_realization"]
+    local_files = sorted(
+        {
+            relative
+            for lane in ("hard_executor", "regional_condition", "regional_evaluation")
+            for relative in current[lane]
+        }
+    )
+    local_hashes = {relative: sha256_file(ROOT / relative) for relative in local_files}
+    reference = ReferenceProcessConfig()
+    if tuple(current["required_regional_fields"]) != FIELDS:
+        raise ValueError("COMPOSE regional morphology fields changed")
+    if (
+        reference.rate_factorization != current["required_rate_factorization"]
+        or reference.ring_template_factorization
+        != current["required_ring_factorization"]
+        or reference.enable_ring_restates is not current["required_ring_restates"]
+        or reference.enable_cyclic_graft is not current["required_cyclic_graft"]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("COMPOSE reference-process ring contract changed")
+    required_words = (
+        "self loops",
+        "duplicate edges",
+        "valence overflow",
+        "No terminal graph repair",
+    )
+    cycle_contract = config["ported_invariants"]["cycle_validity"]
+    if any(word not in cycle_contract for word in required_words):
+        raise ValueError("cycle-validity contract is incomplete")
+    if len(config["evaluation_gates"]) < 7 or len(config["not_ported"]) < 7:
+        raise ValueError("FORGE port boundaries are incomplete")
+
+    summary = {
+        "schema": "forge_inductive_bias_port_v1_summary",
+        "status": "PASS",
+        "forge_commit": config["forge_source"]["commit"],
+        "forge_files_verified": len(observed_forge),
+        "compose_files_bound": len(local_hashes),
+        "regional_fields": list(FIELDS),
+        "ring_template_factorization": reference.ring_template_factorization,
+        "rate_factorization": reference.rate_factorization,
+        "ring_restates": reference.enable_ring_restates,
+        "cyclic_graft": reference.enable_cyclic_graft,
+        "evaluation_gates": len(config["evaluation_gates"]),
+        "biology_used": False,
+        "beae_outcomes_used": False,
+        "training_admissible": False,
+    }
+    OUTPUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    publish_json(OUTPUT / "summary.json", summary)
+    publish_json(
+        OUTPUT / "receipt.json",
+        {
+            "schema": "forge_inductive_bias_port_v1_receipt",
+            "complete": True,
+            "inputs": {
+                str(CONFIG.relative_to(ROOT)): sha256_file(CONFIG),
+                **{
+                    "../forge/" + relative: value
+                    for relative, value in sorted(observed_forge.items())
+                },
+            },
+            "compose_implementation": local_hashes,
+            "producers": {
+                str(Path(__file__).resolve().relative_to(ROOT)): sha256_file(
+                    Path(__file__).resolve()
+                )
+            },
+            "outputs": {"summary.json": sha256_file(OUTPUT / "summary.json")},
+            "training_admissible": False,
+        },
+    )
+    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
+    return summary
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    build()

+"""Independently audit the structure-resolved v8.1 generator split."""

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import gzip
+import json
+from collections import Counter, defaultdict
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from compose_lipid.data.assets import sha256_file

+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SPLIT_DIR = (
+    ROOT / "artifacts/corpus_build_v2/post_instruction_generator_splits_v8_1"
+)

+COMPONENT_DIR = (
+    ROOT / "artifacts/corpus_build_v2/post_instruction_component_manifest_v8_1"
+)
+OUTPUT = ROOT / "audits/post_instruction_generator_splits_v8_1_independent.json"
+
+
+def rows(path: Path):
+    opener = gzip.open if path.suffix == ".gz" else open
+    with opener(path, "rt") as handle:
+        yield from map(json.loads, handle)
+
+
+def _check_receipt(directory: Path) -> dict:
+    receipt = json.loads((directory / "receipt.json").read_text())
+    if receipt.get("complete") is not True:
+        raise ValueError("split receipt is incomplete")
+    for name, expected in receipt["inputs"].items():
+        if sha256_file(ROOT / name) != expected:
+            raise ValueError("changed bound input: " + name)
+    for name, expected in receipt["producers"].items():
+        if sha256_file(ROOT / name) != expected:
+            raise ValueError("changed producer: " + name)
+    for name, expected in receipt["outputs"].items():
+        if sha256_file(directory / name) != expected:
+            raise ValueError("changed split output: " + name)
+    return receipt
+
+
+def build() -> dict:
+    receipt = _check_receipt(SPLIT_DIR)
+    assignments = {
+        row["target_id"]: row for row in rows(SPLIT_DIR / "assignments.jsonl.gz")
+    }
+    groups = {
+        row["target_id"]: row for row in rows(SPLIT_DIR / "split_groups.jsonl.gz")
+    }
+    selected = json.loads((SPLIT_DIR / "selected_groups.json").read_text())
+    summary = json.loads((SPLIT_DIR / "summary.json").read_text())
+    if len(assignments) != 200_000 or set(assignments) != set(groups):
+        raise ValueError("split membership is incomplete or inconsistent")
+
+    split_counts = Counter(row["split"] for row in assignments.values())
+    panel_counts = Counter(
+        panel for row in assignments.values() for panel in row["test_panels"]
+    )
+    if dict(sorted(split_counts.items())) != summary["split_counts"]:
+        raise ValueError("summary split counts differ from assignments")
+    if dict(sorted(panel_counts.items())) != summary["panel_counts"]:
+        raise ValueError("summary panel counts differ from assignments")
+    if any(
+        row["split"] == "test" and not row["test_panels"]
+        for row in assignments.values()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("formal test target lacks a named panel")
+    if any(
+        row["split"] != "test" and row["test_panels"]
+        for row in assignments.values()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("non-test target has a test panel")
+
+    train_ids = {target_id for target_id, row in assignments.items() if row["split"] == "train"}
+    test_ids = {target_id for target_id, row in assignments.items() if row["split"] == "test"}
+    calibration_ids = {
+        target_id
+        for target_id, row in assignments.items()
+        if row["split"] == "calibration"
+    }
+    reference_ids = {
+        target_id
+        for target_id, row in assignments.items()
+        if row["split"] == "reference"
+    }
+    if any(
+        left & right
+        for index, left in enumerate(
+            (train_ids, test_ids, calibration_ids, reference_ids)
+        )
+        for right in (train_ids, test_ids, calibration_ids, reference_ids)[index + 1 :]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("split partitions overlap")
+
+    train_components = set()
+    train_family_components = set()
+    train_combinations = set()
+    train_studies = set()
+    train_morphologies = set()
+    for target_id in train_ids:
+        group = groups[target_id]
+        family = group["family"]
+        train_components.update(group["component_ids"])
+        train_family_components.update(
+            (family, component_id) for component_id in group["component_ids"]
+        )
+        train_combinations.add((family, assignments[target_id]["combination_signature"]))
+        train_studies.update(
+            "pmid:" + str(value).removeprefix("pmid:")
+            for value in group.get("source_pmids", [])
+        )
+        train_morphologies.add(
+            (family, assignments[target_id]["morphology_group_signature"])

+"""Independently audit the frozen train-only v8.1 target measure."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import gzip
+import json
+import math
+from collections import Counter, defaultdict
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from compose_lipid.data.assets import sha256_file
+from compose_lipid.data.source_inventory import publish_json
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUT = ROOT / "artifacts/corpus_build_v2/post_instruction_target_measure_v8_1"
+SPLITS = ROOT / "artifacts/corpus_build_v2/post_instruction_generator_splits_v8_1"
+RELEASE = ROOT / "artifacts/corpus_build_v2/post_instruction_balanced_release_v8"
+AUDIT = ROOT / "audits/post_instruction_target_measure_v8_1_independent.json"
+
+
+def rows(path: Path):
+    opener = gzip.open if path.suffix == ".gz" else open
+    with opener(path, "rt") as handle:
+        yield from map(json.loads, handle)
+
+
+def build() -> dict:
+    receipt = json.loads((OUT / "receipt.json").read_text())
+    if receipt.get("complete") is not True:
+        raise ValueError("target-measure receipt is incomplete")
+    for name, expected in receipt["inputs"].items():
+        if sha256_file(ROOT / name) != expected:
+            raise ValueError("changed target-measure input: " + name)
+    for name, expected in receipt["producers"].items():
+        if sha256_file(ROOT / name) != expected:
+            raise ValueError("changed target-measure producer: " + name)
+    for name, expected in receipt["outputs"].items():
+        if sha256_file(OUT / name) != expected:
+            raise ValueError("changed target-measure output: " + name)
+
+    assignments = {
+        row["target_id"]: row for row in rows(SPLITS / "assignments.jsonl.gz")
+    }
+    accepted = {
+        row["target_id"]: row
+        for row in rows(RELEASE / "accepted_targets.jsonl.gz")
+    }
+    train_ids = {
+        target_id
+        for target_id, assignment in assignments.items()
+        if assignment["split"] == "train"
+    }
+    measure = list(rows(OUT / "target_measure.jsonl.gz"))
+    joint = list(rows(OUT / "joint_target_conditioning.jsonl.gz"))
+    groups = list(rows(OUT / "joint_conditioning_groups.jsonl.gz"))
+    measure_by_id = {row["target_id"]: row for row in measure}
+    joint_by_id = {row["target_id"]: row for row in joint}
+    if len(measure_by_id) != len(measure) or set(measure_by_id) != train_ids:
+        raise ValueError("measure membership is not exactly the frozen train set")
+    if set(joint_by_id) != train_ids:
+        raise ValueError("joint conditioning membership differs from train")
+    if any(
+        assignments[target_id]["split"] != "train" for target_id in measure_by_id
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("calibration, test, or reference row entered fit")
+
+    probability_sum = sum(row["probability"] for row in measure)
+    if not math.isclose(probability_sum, 1.0, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-12):
+        raise ValueError("measure is not normalized")
+    family_mass = defaultdict(float)
+    family_stratum_values = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(set))
+    supervision_modes = Counter()
+    source_mass = 0.0
+    for row in measure:
+        target_id = row["target_id"]
+        family = row["family"]
+        if accepted[target_id]["primary_family"] != family:
+            raise ValueError("measure family differs from release")
+        expected_evidence = "source" if accepted[target_id]["source_anchor"] else "virtual"
+        if row["evidence_stratum"] != expected_evidence:
+            raise ValueError("measure evidence differs from release")
+        family_mass[family] += row["probability"]
+        family_stratum_values[family][expected_evidence].add(row["probability"])
+        supervision_modes[row["supervision_mode"]] += 1
+        if expected_evidence == "source":
+            source_mass += row["probability"]
+        if not math.isclose(
+            row["probability"],
+            joint_by_id[target_id]["probability"],
+            rel_tol=0.0,
+            abs_tol=0.0,
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("joint target probability differs from measure")
+
+    expected_family_mass = 1.0 / len(family_mass)
+    for family, value in family_mass.items():
+        if not math.isclose(value, expected_family_mass, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-12):
+            raise ValueError("family mass differs: " + family)
+    boost_by_family = {}
+    for family, strata in family_stratum_values.items():
+        if any(len(values) != 1 for values in strata.values()):
+            raise ValueError("within-family evidence stratum is not uniform")
+        if "source" in strata and "virtual" in strata:
+            source_probability = next(iter(strata["source"]))
+            virtual_probability = next(iter(strata["virtual"]))
+            boost = source_probability / virtual_probability
+            if boost < 1.0 - 1e-12 or boost > 4.0 + 1e-12:
+                raise ValueError("source per-target boost is outside [1,4]")
+            boost_by_family[family] = boost
+
+    group_probability_sum = sum(row["probability"] for row in groups)
+    if not math.isclose(group_probability_sum, 1.0, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-12):
+        raise ValueError("joint group measure is not normalized")
+    if sum(row["target_count"] for row in groups) != len(measure):
+        raise ValueError("joint groups do not cover every weighted target")
+    policy = json.loads((OUT / "sampling_policy.json").read_text())
+    if policy["michael_or_beae_family_multiplier"] != 1.0:
+        raise ValueError("base measure contains a Michael/BEAE family tilt")
+    if policy["fit_partition"] != "train_only":
+        raise ValueError("target measure was not declared train-only")
+
+    audit = {
+        "schema": "post_instruction_target_measure_v8_1_independent_audit",
+        "audited_receipt_sha256": sha256_file(OUT / "receipt.json"),
+        "weighted_training_targets": len(measure),
+        "training_families": len(family_mass),
+        "target_probability_sum": probability_sum,
+        "joint_group_probability_sum": group_probability_sum,
+        "joint_conditioning_groups": len(groups),
+        "expected_family_probability_mass": expected_family_mass,
+        "maximum_family_mass_absolute_error": max(
+            abs(value - expected_family_mass) for value in family_mass.values()
+        ),
+        "realized_global_source_mass": source_mass,
+        "source_per_target_boost_by_mixed_family": dict(sorted(boost_by_family.items())),
+        "maximum_source_per_target_boost": max(boost_by_family.values()),
+        "training_supervision_mode_counts": dict(sorted(supervision_modes.items())),
+        "calibration_targets_used_to_fit": 0,
+        "test_targets_used_to_fit": 0,
+        "michael_or_beae_family_bias_applied": False,
+        "biology_used": False,
+        "beae_outcomes_used": False,
+        "passed": True,
+    }
+    publish_json(AUDIT, audit)
+    print(json.dumps(audit, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
+    return audit
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    build()

+"""Freeze calibration exact-path plans without changing train-derived support."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import gzip
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from compose_lipid.data.assets import sha256_file
+from compose_lipid.data.source_inventory import publish_json
+from compose_lipid.data.training_corpus import digest
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+CONFIG = ROOT / "configs/corpus/post_instruction_calibration_exact_path_plan_v8_1.json"
+
+
+def rows(path: Path):
+    with gzip.open(path, "rt") as handle:
+        yield from map(json.loads, handle)
+
+
+def publish_gzip(path: Path, records: list[dict]) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=path.parent, delete=False) as raw:
+        temporary = Path(raw.name)
+        with gzip.GzipFile(
+            fileobj=raw, mode="wb", filename="", mtime=0, compresslevel=6
+        ) as stream:
+            for row in records:
+                stream.write(
+                    (
+                        json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
+                    ).encode()
+                )
+        raw.flush()
+        os.fsync(raw.fileno())
+    if path.exists():
+        if sha256_file(path) != sha256_file(temporary):
+            temporary.unlink()
+            raise ValueError("refusing to overwrite changed exact-path plan shard")
+        temporary.unlink()
+    else:
+        os.replace(temporary, path)
+
+
+def build() -> dict:
+    config = json.loads(CONFIG.read_text())
+    if any(
+        config[key]
+        for key in (
+            "gpu_used",
+            "biology_used",
+            "beae_outcomes_used",
+            "training_admissible",
+        )
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("calibration exact-path planning must remain chemistry-only")
+    if (
+        config.get("split") != "calibration"
+        or config.get("support_fit_split") != "train"
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "calibration paths must be evaluated against train-only support"
+        )
+    inputs = {str(CONFIG.relative_to(ROOT)): sha256_file(CONFIG)}
+    bound = {}
+    for label in ("program_package", "model_support", "path_probe"):
+        path = ROOT / config[f"{label}_receipt"]
+        expected = config[f"{label}_receipt_sha256"]
+        if sha256_file(path) != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"changed {label} receipt")
+        receipt = json.loads(path.read_text())
+        if receipt.get("complete") is not True:
+            raise ValueError(f"incomplete {label} release")
+        inputs[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))] = expected
+        bound[label] = (path, receipt)
+    if not bound["path_probe"][1].get("exact_path_probe_passed"):
+        raise ValueError("full exact paths require a passed bounded probe")
+
+    package_root = bound["program_package"][0].parent
+    output_root = ROOT / config["output_dir"]
+    shard_specs = []
+    target_ids = set()
+    families = Counter()
+    modes = Counter()
+    steps = 0
+    for spec in bound["program_package"][1]["shards"]:
+        receipt_path = package_root / spec["receipt"]
+        package_path = package_root / spec["path"]
+        if (
+            sha256_file(receipt_path) != spec["receipt_sha256"]
+            or sha256_file(package_path) != spec["sha256"]
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("changed local program-package mirror")
+        plan = []
+        for row in rows(package_path):
+            if row["target_id"] in target_ids:
+                raise ValueError("duplicate target in program packages")
+            target_ids.add(row["target_id"])
+            program_steps = len(row["program_payload"]["witness"]["program"]["steps"])
+            plan.append(
+                {
+                    "split": "calibration",
+                    "target_id": row["target_id"],
+                    "task_id": row["task_id"],
+                    "family": row["family"],
+                    "source_anchor": row["source_anchor"],
+                    "resolution_mode": row["resolution_mode"],
+                    "program_payload_sha256": row["program_payload_sha256"],
+                    "program_steps": program_steps,
+                }
+            )
+            families[row["family"]] += 1
+            modes[row["resolution_mode"]] += 1
+            steps += program_steps
+        plan.sort(key=lambda row: row["target_id"])
+        path = output_root / f"plan_{spec['shard']:03d}.jsonl.gz"
+        publish_gzip(path, plan)
+        shard_specs.append(
+            {
+                "shard": spec["shard"],
+                "path": path.name,
+                "sha256": sha256_file(path),
+                "targets": len(plan),
+                "package_sha256": spec["sha256"],
+            }
+        )
+    if (
+        len(target_ids) != config["expected_targets"]
+        or len(families) != config["expected_families"]
+        or steps != config["expected_program_steps"]
+        or len(shard_specs) != config["worker_shards"]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("exact-path plan coverage changed")
+    summary = {
+        "schema": "post_instruction_calibration_exact_path_plan_v8_1_summary",
+        "status": "PASS",
+        "split": "calibration",
+        "support_fit_split": "train",
+        "targets": len(target_ids),
+        "families": len(families),
+        "family_counts": dict(sorted(families.items())),
+        "resolution_modes": dict(sorted(modes.items())),
+        "program_steps": steps,
+        "worker_shards": len(shard_specs),
+        "cpus_per_worker": 1,
+        "path_probe_passed": True,
+        "gpu_used": False,
+        "biology_used": False,
+        "beae_outcomes_used": False,
+        "training_admissible": False,
+    }
+    publish_json(output_root / "summary.json", summary)
+    receipt = {
+        "schema": "post_instruction_calibration_exact_path_plan_v8_1_receipt",
+        "complete": True,
+        "inputs": dict(sorted(inputs.items())),
+        "producers": {
+            str(Path(__file__).relative_to(ROOT)): sha256_file(Path(__file__))
+        },
+        "shards": shard_specs,
+        "outputs": {"summary.json": sha256_file(output_root / "summary.json")},
+        "target_ids_digest": digest(sorted(target_ids)),
+        "training_admissible": False,
+    }
+    publish_json(output_root / "receipt.json", receipt)
+    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
+    return summary
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    build()

+"""Build portable input shards for exact calibration-program projection.
+
+The frozen tasks reference thousands of local source containers.  Shipping all
+of them to each remote worker would stage roughly 1.5 GiB and repeatedly scan
+the same files.  This builder verifies every original content hash once, joins
+only the requested records through a disk-backed SQLite index, and writes one
+compact self-contained input bundle per approved one-CPU worker.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import gzip
+import io
+import json
+import os
+import shutil
+import sqlite3
+import tempfile
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from compose_lipid.data.assets import sha256_file
+from compose_lipid.data.post_instruction_program_io_v8_1 import (
+    manifest_nested_references,
+    reference_key,
+    rows,
+)
+from compose_lipid.data.source_inventory import publish_json
+from compose_lipid.data.training_corpus import digest
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+CONFIG = ROOT / "configs/corpus/post_instruction_calibration_program_inputs_v8_1.json"
+
+
+def _output_sha(receipt: dict, name: str) -> str:
+    value = receipt["outputs"][name]
+    return value["sha256"] if isinstance(value, dict) else value
+
+
+def _reference_json(reference: dict) -> str:
+    return json.dumps(reference, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
+
+
+def _record_json(record: dict) -> str:
+    return json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
+
+
+def _add_reference(connection: sqlite3.Connection, reference: dict) -> None:
+    path, line = reference_key(reference)
+    encoded = _reference_json(reference)
+    existing = connection.execute(
+        "SELECT reference_json FROM refs WHERE path = ? AND line_key = ?",
+        (path, -1 if line is None else line),
+    ).fetchone()
+    if existing is not None:
+        prior = json.loads(existing[0])
+        if prior["sha256"] != reference["sha256"]:
+            raise ValueError("inconsistent source-file binding: " + path)
+        for key in ("payload_sha256", "record_sha256", "task_id"):
+            if (
+                prior.get(key) not in (None, reference.get(key))
+                and reference.get(key) is not None
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("inconsistent bound-record identity")
+        return
+    connection.execute(
+        "INSERT INTO refs(path, line_key, reference_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
+        (path, -1 if line is None else line, encoded),
+    )
+
+
+def _load_requested_records(
+    connection: sqlite3.Connection, source_bindings: dict[str, str]
+) -> None:
+    paths = [
+        row[0]
+        for row in connection.execute(
+            "SELECT DISTINCT path FROM refs WHERE record_json IS NULL ORDER BY path"
+        )
+    ]
+    for position, relative in enumerate(paths, 1):
+        specifications = connection.execute(
+            "SELECT line_key, reference_json FROM refs "
+            "WHERE path = ? AND record_json IS NULL ORDER BY line_key",
+            (relative,),
+        ).fetchall()
+        references = {line: json.loads(encoded) for line, encoded in specifications}
+        expected_hashes = {reference["sha256"] for reference in references.values()}
+        if len(expected_hashes) != 1:
+            raise ValueError("source path has multiple expected hashes: " + relative)
+        expected_hash = expected_hashes.pop()
+        path = ROOT / relative
+        if sha256_file(path) != expected_hash:
+            raise ValueError("changed bound source file: " + relative)
+        source_bindings[relative] = expected_hash
+        if -1 in references:
+            if len(references) != 1:
+                raise ValueError("whole-file and line references cannot be mixed")
+            records = {-1: json.loads(path.read_bytes())}
+        else:
+            wanted = set(references)
+            records = {}
+            for line_number, record in enumerate(rows(path), 1):
+                if line_number in wanted:
+                    records[line_number] = record
+                    wanted.remove(line_number)
+                    if not wanted:
+                        break
+            if wanted:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"missing bound lines in {relative}: {sorted(wanted)[:10]}"

+"""Create a compact 30-shard exact-program plan for frozen calibration targets."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import gzip
+import io
+import json
+import os
+import shutil
+import tempfile
+from collections import Counter
+from contextlib import ExitStack
+from itertools import zip_longest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from compose_lipid.data.assets import sha256_file
+from compose_lipid.data.source_inventory import publish_json
+from compose_lipid.data.training_corpus import digest
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+CONFIG = ROOT / "configs/corpus/post_instruction_calibration_program_plan_v8_1.json"
+
+
+def rows(path: Path):
+    opener = gzip.open if path.suffix == ".gz" else open
+    with opener(path, "rt") as handle:
+        yield from map(json.loads, handle)
+
+
+def output_sha(receipt: dict, name: str) -> str:
+    value = receipt["outputs"][name]
+    return value["sha256"] if isinstance(value, dict) else value
+
+
+def _bound_receipt(config: dict, key: str, bindings: dict) -> tuple[Path, dict]:
+    path = ROOT / config[f"{key}_receipt"]
+    expected = config[f"{key}_receipt_sha256"]
+    if sha256_file(path) != expected:
+        raise ValueError("changed plan input receipt: " + key)
+    receipt = json.loads(path.read_text())
+    if receipt.get("complete") is not True:
+        raise ValueError("incomplete plan input receipt: " + key)
+    bindings[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))] = expected
+    return path.parent, receipt
+
+
+def _bound_output(directory: Path, receipt: dict, name: str, bindings: dict) -> Path:
+    path = directory / name
+    expected = output_sha(receipt, name)
+    if sha256_file(path) != expected:
+        raise ValueError("changed plan input output: " + name)
+    bindings[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))] = expected
+    return path
+
+
+RESOLUTION_MODES = {
+    "lnpdb_compatible_decomposition_replay": "project_bound_compatible_decomposition",
+    "prior_exact_reaction_program": "reuse_bound_exact_source_program",
+    "v8_exact_bound_family_grid_replay": "project_v8_bound_family_grid",
+    "v8_exact_family_task_replay": "project_v8_exact_family_task",
+}
+
+
+def build() -> dict:
+    config = json.loads(CONFIG.read_text())
+    if any(
+        config[key]
+        for key in ("biology_used", "beae_outcomes_used", "gpu_used", "modal_used")
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "program planning must remain local, CPU-only, and outcome-blind"
+        )
+    if config["training_admissible"]:
+        raise ValueError("program planning cannot assert runtime readiness")
+    if config["cpus_per_worker"] != 1 or config["worker_shards"] != 30:
+        raise ValueError("approved restartable 30 x 1-CPU plan changed")
+
+    bindings = {str(CONFIG.relative_to(ROOT)): sha256_file(CONFIG)}
+    release_dir, release_receipt = _bound_receipt(config, "release", bindings)
+    supervision_dir, supervision_receipt = _bound_receipt(
+        config, "supervision", bindings
+    )
+    support_dir, support_receipt = _bound_receipt(config, "model_support", bindings)
+    release_path = _bound_output(
+        release_dir, release_receipt, "accepted_targets.jsonl.gz", bindings
+    )
+    supervision_path = _bound_output(
+        supervision_dir, supervision_receipt, "manifest.jsonl.gz", bindings
+    )
+    calibration_path = _bound_output(
+        support_dir, support_receipt, "calibration_targets.jsonl.gz", bindings
+    )
+    calibration = {row["target_id"]: row for row in rows(calibration_path)}
+    if len(calibration) != config["expected_targets"] or any(
+        row["split"] != "calibration" for row in calibration.values()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("program plan calibration membership changed")
+
+    out = ROOT / config["output_dir"]
+    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    pending = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".calibration_plan_v8_1_", dir=out))
+    shard_counts = Counter()
+    mode_counts = Counter()
+    family_counts = Counter()
+    task_ids = []
+    output_specs = {}
+    try:
+        with ExitStack() as stack:
+            streams = []
+            temporary_paths = []
+            for shard in range(config["worker_shards"]):
+                path = pending / f"tasks_{shard:03d}.jsonl.gz"
+                raw = stack.enter_context(path.open("xb"))
+                compressed = stack.enter_context(
+                    gzip.GzipFile(
+                        filename="",
+                        fileobj=raw,
+                        mode="wb",
+                        mtime=0,
+                        compresslevel=6,
+                    )
+                )
+                stream = stack.enter_context(
+                    io.TextIOWrapper(compressed, encoding="utf-8")
+                )
+                streams.append(stream)
+                temporary_paths.append(path)
+
+            supervision_line = 0
+            scheduled = set()
+            for release, supervision in zip_longest(
+                rows(release_path), rows(supervision_path), fillvalue=None
+            ):
+                supervision_line += 1
+                if release is None or supervision is None:
+                    raise ValueError("release and supervision row counts differ")
+                target_id = release["target_id"]
+                if supervision["target_id"] != target_id:
+                    raise ValueError("release and supervision order differs")
+                target = calibration.get(target_id)
+                if target is None:
+                    continue
+                if target["family"] != release["primary_family"]:
+                    raise ValueError("calibration and supervision binding changed")
+                mode = RESOLUTION_MODES.get(supervision["supervision_mode"])
+                if mode is None:
+                    raise ValueError("unregistered supervision resolution mode")
+                task_id = digest(
+                    ["post_instruction_calibration_program_task_v8_1", target_id]
+                )
+                shard = (
+                    int(
+                        digest(
+                            [
+                                "post_instruction_calibration_program_shard_v8_1",
+                                target_id,
+                            ]
+                        )[:16],
+                        16,
+                    )
+                    % config["worker_shards"]
+                )
+                task = {
+                    "task_id": task_id,
+                    "target_id": target_id,
+                    "family": release["primary_family"],
+                    "constitutional_smiles": release["constitution"],
+                    "probability": 0.0,
+                    "split": "calibration",
+                    "source_anchor": release["source_anchor"],
+                    "supervision_mode": supervision["supervision_mode"],
+                    "resolution_mode": mode,
+                    "supervision_reference": {
+                        "path": str(supervision_path.relative_to(ROOT)),
+                        "line": supervision_line,
+                        "payload_sha256": digest(supervision),
+                        "sha256": output_sha(
+                            supervision_receipt, supervision_path.name
+                        ),
+                    },
+                    "training_admissible": False,
+                }
+                streams[shard].write(
+                    json.dumps(task, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
+                )
+                if target_id in scheduled:
+                    raise ValueError("duplicate program-projection target")
+                scheduled.add(target_id)
+                task_ids.append(task_id)
+                shard_counts[shard] += 1
+                mode_counts[mode] += 1
+                family_counts[release["primary_family"]] += 1
+
+        if (
+            len(scheduled) != config["expected_targets"]
+            or set(calibration) != scheduled
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("program plan does not cover the frozen calibration panel")
+        if dict(mode_counts) != config["expected_resolution_modes"]:
+            raise ValueError("program plan resolution-mode counts changed")
+        if dict(family_counts) != config["expected_family_counts"]:
+            raise ValueError("program plan family counts changed")
+
+        for shard, temporary_path in enumerate(temporary_paths):
+            with temporary_path.open("rb") as handle:
+                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+            final = out / temporary_path.name
+            sha = sha256_file(temporary_path)
+            if final.exists():
+                if sha256_file(final) != sha:
+                    raise ValueError("refusing to overwrite changed task shard")
+                temporary_path.unlink()
+            else:
+                os.replace(temporary_path, final)
+            output_specs[final.name] = {
+                "rows": shard_counts[shard],
+                "bytes": final.stat().st_size,
+                "sha256": sha,
+            }
+    finally:
+        shutil.rmtree(pending, ignore_errors=True)
+
+    summary = {
+        "schema": "post_instruction_calibration_program_plan_v8_1_summary",
+        "tasks": len(task_ids),
+        "families": len(family_counts),
+        "resolution_modes": dict(sorted(mode_counts.items())),
+        "family_counts": dict(sorted(family_counts.items())),
+        "worker_shards": config["worker_shards"],
+        "cpus_per_worker": config["cpus_per_worker"],
+        "memory_mib_per_worker": config["memory_mib_per_worker"],
+        "minimum_shard_tasks": min(shard_counts.values()),
+        "maximum_shard_tasks": max(shard_counts.values()),
+        "restartable_shards": True,
+        "biology_used": False,
+        "beae_outcomes_used": False,
+        "gpu_used": False,
+        "modal_used": False,
+        "training_ready": False,
+        "training_admissible": False,
+    }
+    publish_json(out / "summary.json", summary)
+    producers = {str(Path(__file__).relative_to(ROOT)): sha256_file(Path(__file__))}
+    outputs = {
+        **dict(sorted(output_specs.items())),
+        "summary.json": sha256_file(out / "summary.json"),
+    }
+    publish_json(
+        out / "receipt.json",
+        {
+            "schema": "post_instruction_calibration_program_plan_v8_1_receipt",
+            "complete": True,
+            "inputs": dict(sorted(bindings.items())),
+            "producers": producers,
+            "outputs": outputs,
+            "task_ids_digest": digest(sorted(task_ids)),
+            "training_ready": False,
+            "training_admissible": False,
+        },
+    )
+    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
+    return summary
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    build()

+        or receipt.get("gpu_used") is not False
+        or receipt.get("test_targets_prepared") is not False

+"""Bind every v8 target to its exact canonical precursor structures.

+import gzip
+import hashlib
+import io
+import json

+    component_identity,
+    virtual_task_components,

+CONFIG = ROOT / "configs/corpus/post_instruction_component_manifest_v8_1.json"
+
+
+def rows(path: Path):
+    opener = gzip.open if path.suffix == ".gz" else open
+    with opener(path, "rt") as handle:
+        yield from map(json.loads, handle)
+
+
+def output_sha(receipt: dict, name: str) -> str:
+    value = receipt["outputs"][name]
+    return value["sha256"] if isinstance(value, dict) else value
+
+
+def payload_digest(value: dict) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(
+        json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
+    ).hexdigest()
+

+def deterministic_gzip(path: Path, records) -> tuple[int, str]:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=path.parent, delete=False) as raw:
+        temporary = Path(raw.name)
+        with gzip.GzipFile(
+            fileobj=raw, mode="wb", filename="", mtime=0, compresslevel=6
+        ) as compressed, io.TextIOWrapper(compressed, encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+            count = 0
+            for record in records:
+                stream.write(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")))
+                stream.write("\n")
+                count += 1
+        raw.flush()
+        os.fsync(raw.fileno())
+    if path.exists():
+        if sha256_file(path) != sha256_file(temporary):
+            temporary.unlink()
+            raise ValueError("refusing to overwrite changed component manifest")
+        temporary.unlink()
+    else:
+        os.replace(temporary, path)
+    return count, sha256_file(path)

+
+def bind_receipt(config: dict, key: str, bindings: dict) -> tuple[Path, dict]:
+    path = ROOT / config[f"{key}_receipt"]
+    expected = config[f"{key}_receipt_sha256"]
+    if sha256_file(path) != expected:
+        raise ValueError("changed bound receipt: " + key)
+    receipt = json.loads(path.read_text())
+    if receipt.get("complete") is not True:
+        raise ValueError("incomplete bound receipt: " + key)
+    bindings[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))] = expected
+    return path.parent, receipt

+    if constitution is None:
+        raise ValueError("unresolved source precursor: " + identifier)

+    return summary

+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    build()

+OUTPUT = ROOT / "artifacts/corpus_build_v2/post_instruction_exact_path_probe_v8_1"
+
+
+def rows(path: Path):
+    with gzip.open(path, "rt") as handle:
+        yield from map(json.loads, handle)
+
+
+def output_hash(receipt: dict, name: str) -> str:
+    value = receipt["outputs"][name]
+    return value["sha256"] if isinstance(value, dict) else value
+
+
+def stable(seed: int, namespace: str, value: str) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(f"{seed}\0{namespace}\0{value}".encode()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def publish_gzip(path: Path, records: list[dict]) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=path.parent, delete=False) as raw:
+        temporary = Path(raw.name)
+        with gzip.GzipFile(
+            fileobj=raw, mode="wb", filename="", mtime=0, compresslevel=6
+        ) as stream:
+            for row in records:
+                stream.write(
+                    (
+                        json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
+                    ).encode()
+                )
+        raw.flush()
+        os.fsync(raw.fileno())
+    if path.exists():
+        if sha256_file(path) != sha256_file(temporary):
+            temporary.unlink()
+            raise ValueError("refusing to overwrite changed path-probe plan")
+        temporary.unlink()
+    else:
+        os.replace(temporary, path)
+
+
+def build() -> dict:
+    RDLogger.DisableLog("rdApp.*")
+    config = json.loads(CONFIG.read_text())
+    inputs = {str(CONFIG.relative_to(ROOT)): sha256_file(CONFIG)}
+    bound = {}
+    for label in ("corpus", "split", "model_support"):
+        path = ROOT / config[f"{label}_receipt"]
+        expected = config[f"{label}_receipt_sha256"]
+        if sha256_file(path) != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"changed {label} receipt")
+        receipt = json.loads(path.read_text())
+        if receipt.get("complete") is not True:
+            raise ValueError(f"incomplete {label} release")
+        inputs[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))] = expected
+        bound[label] = (path, receipt)
+
+    corpus_path = bound["corpus"][0].parent / "accepted_targets.jsonl.gz"
+    assignment_path = bound["split"][0].parent / "assignments.jsonl.gz"
+    index_path = bound["model_support"][0].parent / "program_index.jsonl.gz"
+    for path, receipt, name in (
+        (corpus_path, bound["corpus"][1], "accepted_targets.jsonl.gz"),
+        (assignment_path, bound["split"][1], "assignments.jsonl.gz"),
+        (index_path, bound["model_support"][1], "program_index.jsonl.gz"),
+    ):
+        expected = output_hash(receipt, name)
+        if sha256_file(path) != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"changed bound output: {name}")
+        inputs[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))] = expected
+
+    assignments = {row["target_id"]: row for row in rows(assignment_path)}
+    programs = {row["target_id"]: row for row in rows(index_path)}
+    targets = {}
+    for row in rows(corpus_path):
+        if assignments[row["target_id"]]["split"] != "train":
+            continue
+        molecule = Chem.MolFromSmiles(row["constitution"])
+        if molecule is None:
+            raise ValueError("path-probe target no longer parses")
+        targets[row["target_id"]] = {
+            **row,
+            "contains_bromine": any(
+                atom.GetSymbol() == "Br" for atom in molecule.GetAtoms()
+            ),
+            "contains_ring": molecule.GetRingInfo().NumRings() > 0,
+        }

+        raise ValueError("train corpus and program index differ")
+
+    reasons = defaultdict(set)
+    seed = config["selection_seed"]
+
+    def choose(candidates, count: int, reason: str) -> None:
+        ordered = sorted(
+            candidates,
+            key=lambda row: stable(seed, reason, row["target_id"]),
+        )
+        for row in ordered[:count]:
+            reasons[row["target_id"]].add(reason)
+
+    strata = defaultdict(list)
+    for target_id, program in programs.items():
+        strata[
+            (
+                program["family"],
+                program["resolution_mode"],
+                bool(program["source_anchor"]),
+            )
+        ].append({**targets[target_id], **program})
+    for key, candidates in sorted(strata.items()):
+        choose(
+            candidates,
+            config["per_family_mode_evidence"],
+            "family_mode_evidence:" + "|".join(map(str, key)),
+        )
+    for family in sorted({row["family"] for row in programs.values()}):
+        family_rows = [
+            targets[target_id]
+            for target_id, row in programs.items()
+            if row["family"] == family
+        ]
+        choose(
+            [row for row in family_rows if row["contains_ring"]],
+            1,
+            f"ring:{family}",
+        )
+        choose(
+            [row for row in family_rows if not row["contains_ring"]],
+            1,
+            f"acyclic:{family}",
+        )
+    choose(
+        [row for row in targets.values() if row["contains_bromine"]],
+        config["bromine_targets"],
+        "bromine_support",
+    )
+    choose(
+        [
+            row
+            for row in targets.values()
+            if row["source_anchor"] and row["heavy_atoms"] > 80
+        ],
+        config["source_targets_above_80"],
+        "reported_source_above_virtual_limit",
+    )
+    for target_id in config["required_target_ids"]:
+        if target_id not in targets:
+            raise ValueError("required exact-path probe target is not in train")
+        reasons[target_id].add("required_regression")
+
+    uncovered_roles = set().union(
+        *(set(row["exact_roles"]) for row in programs.values())
+    )
+    selected_roles = set().union(
+        *(set(programs[target_id]["exact_roles"]) for target_id in reasons)
+    )
+    for role in sorted(uncovered_roles - selected_roles):
+        choose(
+            [row for row in programs.values() if role in row["exact_roles"]],
+            1,
+            f"role:{role}",
+        )
+
+    plan = []
+    for target_id in sorted(reasons):
+        target, program = targets[target_id], programs[target_id]
+        plan.append(
+            {
+                "target_id": target_id,
+                "task_id": program["task_id"],
+                "family": program["family"],
+                "source_anchor": program["source_anchor"],
+                "resolution_mode": program["resolution_mode"],
+                "program_payload_sha256": program["program_payload_sha256"],
+                "heavy_atoms": target["heavy_atoms"],
+                "contains_bromine": target["contains_bromine"],
+                "contains_ring": target["contains_ring"],
+                "selection_reasons": sorted(reasons[target_id]),
+            }
+        )
+    if len(plan) > config["max_probe_targets"]:
+        raise ValueError("exact-path probe exceeds its fixed bound")
+    summary = {
+        "schema": "post_instruction_exact_path_probe_v8_1_plan_summary",
+        "targets": len(plan),
+        "families": len({row["family"] for row in plan}),
+        "resolution_modes": len({row["resolution_mode"] for row in plan}),
+        "source_anchors": sum(row["source_anchor"] for row in plan),
+        "bromine_targets": sum(row["contains_bromine"] for row in plan),
+        "ring_targets": sum(row["contains_ring"] for row in plan),
+        "above_80_source_targets": sum(row["heavy_atoms"] > 80 for row in plan),
+        "exact_roles_covered": len(
+            set().union(
+                *(set(programs[row["target_id"]]["exact_roles"]) for row in plan)
+            )
+        ),
+        "gpu_used": False,
+        "biology_used": False,
+        "beae_outcomes_used": False,
+        "training_admissible": False,

+    publish_json(OUTPUT / "summary.json", summary)

+        "schema": "post_instruction_exact_path_probe_v8_1_plan_receipt",
+        "complete": True,
+        "inputs": dict(sorted(inputs.items())),
+        "producers": {
+            str(Path(__file__).relative_to(ROOT)): sha256_file(Path(__file__))
+        },
+        "outputs": {
+            "plan.jsonl.gz": sha256_file(OUTPUT / "plan.jsonl.gz"),
+            "summary.json": sha256_file(OUTPUT / "summary.json"),
+        },
+        "training_admissible": False,
+    }
+    publish_json(OUTPUT / "receipt.json", receipt)
+    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
+    return summary
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    build()

+        or receipt.get("training_launch_ready") is not False
+        or receipt.get("test_rows_prepared") is not False
+        or receipt.get("gpu_used") is not False

+        or counts.get("training_steps") != 6_000
+        or counts.get("training_rows") != 24_000

+    batch_sha = sha256_file(batch_receipt)

+    config = {

+        "authorization": ("user_2026-09-18_full_authorization_for_modal_after_exact_cpu_readiness"),

+        "training_authorized": True,
+        "formal_test_used": False,
+        "beae_structures_used": False,
+        "beae_outcomes_used": False,
+        "automatic_retries": 0,
+        "production_replacement": False,
+        "batch_receipt_sha256": batch_sha,
+        "core_commit": "945dec00905ed5a0e7d4fe582dda7c5ba77e01f8",
+        "charged_port_policy": CHARGED_PORT_POLICY,

+            "seconds_per_arm_max": 1_500,
+            "checkpoint_interval": 750,
+        },
+        "gpu": "A100-40GB",
+        "volume": "compose-lipid-reference-production-v1",
+        "volume_namespace": "post_instruction_health_v8_1_" + batch_sha[:16],

+        ),

+        "decisions": {name: sha256_file(ROOT / name) for name in sorted(DECISIONS)},
+    }
+    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temporary = output.with_suffix(output.suffix + ".tmp")
+    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(config, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
+    os.replace(temporary, output)
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "output": str(output),
+                "batch_receipt_sha256": batch_sha,
+                "volume_namespace": config["volume_namespace"],
+                "arms": config["arms"],
+                "steps": recipe["steps"],
+            },
+            indent=2,
+            sort_keys=True,
+        )
+    )
+    return config
+
+
+def main(argv=None) -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("batch_receipt", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=OUTPUT)
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    build(args.batch_receipt, args.output)

+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Freeze structure-resolved grouped splits for the broad v8 lipid release."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import gzip
+import io
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+from collections import Counter
+from itertools import zip_longest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdMolDescriptors
+
+from compose_lipid.data.assets import sha256_file
+from compose_lipid.data.generator_splits_v2 import make_generator_splits_v2
+from compose_lipid.data.source_inventory import publish_json
+from compose_lipid.data.training_corpus import digest
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+CONFIG = ROOT / "configs/corpus/post_instruction_generator_splits_v8_1.json"
+
+
+def rows(path: Path):
+    opener = gzip.open if path.suffix == ".gz" else open
+    with opener(path, "rt") as handle:
+        yield from map(json.loads, handle)
+
+
+def output_sha(receipt: dict, name: str) -> str:
+    value = receipt["outputs"][name]
+    return value["sha256"] if isinstance(value, dict) else value
+
+
+def publish_gzip_jsonl(path: Path, records: list[dict]) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=path.parent, delete=False) as raw:
+        temporary = Path(raw.name)
+        with gzip.GzipFile(
+            fileobj=raw, mode="wb", filename="", mtime=0, compresslevel=6
+        ) as compressed, io.TextIOWrapper(compressed, encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+            for row in records:
+                stream.write(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")))
+                stream.write("\n")
+        raw.flush()
+        os.fsync(raw.fileno())
+    if path.exists():
+        if sha256_file(path) != sha256_file(temporary):
+            temporary.unlink()
+            raise ValueError("refusing to overwrite changed split output: " + path.name)
+        temporary.unlink()
+    else:
+        os.replace(temporary, path)
+
+
+def molecule_profile(smiles: str) -> dict:
+    """Coarse whole-molecule morphology used only for grouped evaluation."""
+
+    molecule = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles)
+    if molecule is None:
+        raise ValueError("split target does not parse")
+    carbons = [atom for atom in molecule.GetAtoms() if atom.GetAtomicNum() == 6]
+    return {
+        "heavy_atom_band": molecule.GetNumHeavyAtoms() // 8,
+        "carbon_band": len(carbons) // 6,
+        "formal_charge": Chem.GetFormalCharge(molecule),
+        "ring_count": min(4, rdMolDescriptors.CalcNumRings(molecule)),
+        "carbon_branch_points": min(
+            4,
+            sum(
+                sum(
+                    neighbor.GetAtomicNum() == 6 for neighbor in atom.GetNeighbors()
+                )
+                >= 3
+                for atom in carbons
+            ),
+        ),
+        "cc_double_bonds": min(
+            4,
+            sum(
+                bond.GetBondType() == Chem.BondType.DOUBLE
+                and bond.GetBeginAtom().GetAtomicNum() == 6
+                and bond.GetEndAtom().GetAtomicNum() == 6
+                for bond in molecule.GetBonds()
+            ),
+        ),
+        "nitrogen_band": sum(
+            atom.GetAtomicNum() == 7 for atom in molecule.GetAtoms()
+        )
+        // 2,
+        "oxygen_band": sum(
+            atom.GetAtomicNum() == 8 for atom in molecule.GetAtoms()
+        )
+        // 2,
+        "phosphorus_atoms": sum(
+            atom.GetAtomicNum() == 15 for atom in molecule.GetAtoms()
+        ),
+        "sulfur_band": sum(
+            atom.GetAtomicNum() == 16 for atom in molecule.GetAtoms()
+        )
+        // 2,
+    }
+
+
+MORPHOLOGY_FIELDS = {
+    "architecture_stratum",
+    "coupled_ketone_split",
+    "design_lane",
+    "distance",
+    "event_count",
+    "events",
+    "head_arm_count",
+    "interface_stratum",
+    "mechanism",
+    "occupancy",
+    "pair_lane",
+    "reported_released_tuple",
+    "series",
+    "site_disposition",
+}
+
+
+def morphology_metadata(metadata: dict) -> dict:
+    """Retain declared design axes without treating IDs as morphology."""
+
+    return {
+        key: value
+        for key, value in sorted(metadata.items())
+        if key in MORPHOLOGY_FIELDS or key.endswith("_axis")
+    }
+
+
+def _bound_receipt(config: dict, key: str, bindings: dict) -> tuple[Path, dict]:
+    path = ROOT / config[f"{key}_receipt"]
+    expected = config[f"{key}_receipt_sha256"]
+    if sha256_file(path) != expected:
+        raise ValueError("changed parent receipt: " + key)
+    receipt = json.loads(path.read_text())
+    if receipt.get("complete") is not True:
+        raise ValueError("incomplete parent receipt: " + key)
+    bindings[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))] = expected
+    return path.parent, receipt
+
+
+def build() -> dict:
+    config = json.loads(CONFIG.read_text())
+    if any(config[key] for key in ("biology_used", "beae_outcomes_used", "gpu_used")):
+        raise ValueError("split construction must remain chemistry-only and CPU-only")
+    if config["training_admissible"]:
+        raise ValueError("split assignment cannot itself admit training")
+
+    bindings = {str(CONFIG.relative_to(ROOT)): sha256_file(CONFIG)}
+    release_dir, release_receipt = _bound_receipt(config, "release", bindings)
+    component_dir, component_receipt = _bound_receipt(
+        config, "component_manifest", bindings
+    )
+    _bound_receipt(config, "superseded_split", bindings)
+    release_path = release_dir / "accepted_targets.jsonl.gz"
+    component_path = component_dir / "components.jsonl.gz"
+    for path, receipt in (
+        (release_path, release_receipt),
+        (component_path, component_receipt),
+    ):
+        expected = output_sha(receipt, path.name)
+        if sha256_file(path) != expected:
+            raise ValueError("changed bound input: " + path.name)
+        bindings[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))] = expected
+
+    records = []
+    family_counts = Counter()
+    basis_counts = Counter()
+    source_counts = Counter()
+    for release, components in zip_longest(
+        rows(release_path), rows(component_path), fillvalue=None
+    ):
+        if release is None or components is None:
+            raise ValueError("release/component manifest row counts differ")
+        target_id = release["target_id"]
+        family = release["primary_family"]
+        if components["target_id"] != target_id or components["family"] != family:
+            raise ValueError("release/component manifest order or identity changed")
+        instances = [
+            {"role": item["role"], "component_id": item["component_id"]}
+            for item in components["component_instances"]
+        ]
+        component_ids = sorted({item["component_id"] for item in instances})
+        if not component_ids:
+            raise ValueError("target lacks structure-resolved components")
+        core = digest(["post_instruction_family_core_v8_1", family])
+        profile = molecule_profile(release["constitution"])
+        context = (
+            {"source_anchor": True}
+            if release["source_anchor"]
+            else morphology_metadata(release["primary_metadata"])
+        )
+        regional_morphology = digest(
+            [
+                "post_instruction_coarse_regional_morphology_v8_1",
+                family,
+                context,
+                profile,
+                Counter(item["role"] for item in instances),
+            ]
+        )
+        records.append(
+            {
+                "target_id": target_id,
+                "family": family,
+                "component_ids": component_ids,
+                "component_instances": instances,
+                "core_scaffold_signature": core,
+                "regional_morphology_signature": regional_morphology,
+                "regional_profile": profile,
+                "morphology_context": context,
+                "component_binding_basis": components["binding_basis"],
+                "source_anchor": release["source_anchor"],
+                "source_pmids": components.get("source_pmids", []),
+                "source_names": components.get("source_names", []),
+                "evidence_lane": release["admission_lane"],
+            }
+        )
+        family_counts[family] += 1
+        basis_counts[components["binding_basis"]] += 1
+        source_counts["source" if release["source_anchor"] else "virtual"] += 1
+
+    if len(records) != config["expected_targets"]:
+        raise ValueError("split target membership changed")
+    if len({row["target_id"] for row in records}) != len(records):
+        raise ValueError("duplicate split target")
+    trainable = {
+        family
+        for family, count in family_counts.items()
+        if count >= config["minimum_training_class"]
+    }
+    if len(trainable) != config["expected_trainable_families"]:
+        raise ValueError("formal family count changed")
+
+    result = make_generator_splits_v2(
+        records,
+        seed=config["seed"],
+        test_fraction=config["test_fraction"],
+        calibration_fraction=config["calibration_fraction"],
+        minimum_training_class=config["minimum_training_class"],
+    )
