+from compose_lipid.data.generator_splits_v2 import make_generator_splits_v2
+
+
+def synthetic_records():
+    records = []
+    for family in ("f1", "f2"):
+        for index in range(100):
+            head = f"head-{index // 2}"
+            tail = f"tail-{index % 10}"
+            study = [f"{family}-study-{index}"] if index < 4 else []
+            records.append(
+                {
+                    "target_id": f"{family}-{index:03d}",
+                    "family": family,
+                    "component_ids": [head, tail],
+                    "component_instances": [
+                        {"role": "head", "component_id": head},
+                        {"role": "tail", "component_id": tail},
+                    ],
+                    "core_scaffold_signature": family + "-core",
+                    "regional_morphology_signature": f"morph-{index // 2}",
+                    "source_pmids": study,
+                }
+            )
+    return records
+
+
+def test_structure_resolved_split_has_declared_panel_semantics():
+    records = synthetic_records()
+    by_id = {row["target_id"]: row for row in records}
+    result = make_generator_splits_v2(
+        records,
+        seed="unit-test",
+        test_fraction=0.10,
+        calibration_fraction=0.10,
+        minimum_training_class=20,
+    )
+    assignments = {row["target_id"]: row for row in result["assignments"]}
+    assert result["split_counts"] == {
+        "train": 160,
+        "calibration": 20,
+        "test": 20,
+    }
+    assert all(
+        assignment["test_panels"]
+        for assignment in assignments.values()
+        if assignment["split"] == "test"
+    )
+
+    train_components = set()
+    train_family_components = set()
+    train_studies = set()
+    train_combinations = set()
+    for target_id, assignment in assignments.items():
+        if assignment["split"] != "train":
+            continue
+        row = by_id[target_id]
+        train_components.update(row["component_ids"])
+        train_family_components.update(
+            (row["family"], value) for value in row["component_ids"]
+        )
+        train_studies.update(row["source_pmids"])
+        train_combinations.add((row["family"], assignment["combination_signature"]))
+
+    assert not (set(result["selected_components"]) & train_components)
+    assert not (set(result["selected_source_studies"]) & train_studies)
+    for target_id, assignment in assignments.items():
+        if "unseen_exact_component_combination" not in assignment["test_panels"]:
+            continue
+        row = by_id[target_id]
+        assert (
+            row["family"],
+            assignment["combination_signature"],
+        ) not in train_combinations
+        assert not (
+            {(row["family"], value) for value in row["component_ids"]}
+            - train_family_components
+        )
+
+
+def test_globally_shared_component_is_held_out_everywhere_when_selected():
+    records = synthetic_records()
+    # A rare constitution shared across the two formal families must be handled
+    # as one component identity, never as two family-local labels.
+    for record in records:
+        if record["target_id"] in {"f1-098", "f2-098"}:
+            record["component_ids"] = [
+                "globally-shared-rare",
+                record["component_ids"][1],
+            ]
+            record["component_instances"][0]["component_id"] = "globally-shared-rare"
+    result = make_generator_splits_v2(
+        records,
+        seed="shared-component-test",
+        test_fraction=0.10,
+        calibration_fraction=0.10,
+        minimum_training_class=20,
+    )
+    assignments = {row["target_id"]: row for row in result["assignments"]}
+    if "globally-shared-rare" in result["selected_components"]:
+        uses = {
+            row["target_id"]
+            for row in records
+            if "globally-shared-rare" in row["component_ids"]
+        }
+        assert all(assignments[target_id]["split"] == "test" for target_id in uses)

+    target = constitution(
+        "CC(CSCCO)C(=O)OCCOC(=O)CCNCCN(CCN(CCC(=O)OCCOC(=O)C(C)CSCCO)"
+        "CCC(=O)OCCOC(=O)C(C)CSCCO)CCN(CCC(=O)OCCOC(=O)C(C)CSCCO)"

+            step["reaction_id"] == "aema_thiol_methacrylate_v1"
+            for step in program["steps"]
